title: Rabbi Akiva and the Wife Who Waited
summary: Talmidim who left home to learn for twelve years: Rabbi Chananya ben Chachinai, whose wife saw him return and her heart gave out, and Rabbi Chama bar Bisa, who came home and stood up for a young scholar who turned out to be his own son. Then the story of Rabbi Akiva and Kalba Savua's daughter, who sent him away for twelve years and twelve more, "What is mine and yours is hers"; Rav Yosef the son of Rava coming home on Erev Yom Kippur; wine for a woman on her own; and Chuma, Abaye's widow, before Rava.
key_ideas: Don't push off learning: Rabbi Chananya left for yeshiva right away, without waiting.
A wife who sends her husband to learn shares in all of his Torah: "What is mine and yours is hers."
A wife brings out the best in her husband.
Going to learn is like going to the market: you never know what new thing you will find there.
